description: This file contains utility functions and logic for handling media parameters, attachment payloads, sandbox media normalization, and JSON parsing for message actions in a messaging system. It manages media source resolution, payload normalization, and JSON parsing for various message components.

methods.name: readMediaParam
methods.description: Reads a media-related string parameter from args with specified key, without trimming.

methods.name: readAttachmentMediaHint
methods.description: Retrieves media hint from args, checking 'media' and 'mediaUrl' keys.

methods.name: readAttachmentFileHint
methods.description: Retrieves file hint from args, checking 'path', 'filePath', and 'fileUrl' keys.

methods.name: resolveAttachmentMaxBytes
methods.description: Calculates maximum allowed bytes for attachment media based on config, channel, and account settings.

methods.name: inferAttachmentFilename
methods.description: Infers filename for attachment based on media hint or content type.

methods.name: normalizeBase64Payload
methods.description: Normalizes base64 payload, extracting MIME type and payload if data URL format.

methods.name: resolveAttachmentMediaPolicy
methods.description: Determines media policy mode (sandbox or host) based on parameters.

methods.name: buildAttachmentMediaLoadOptions
methods.description: Builds media load options based on media policy, including sandbox validation or outbound load options.

methods.name: hydrateAttachmentPayload
methods.description: Loads media payload into args, normalizing base64 and fetching media if needed.

methods.name: normalizeSandboxMediaParams
methods.description: Normalizes media URLs in args to sandboxed sources if applicable.

methods.name: normalizeSandboxMediaList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of media URLs to sandboxed sources, removing duplicates.

methods.name: hydrateAttachmentActionPayload
methods.description: Prepares attachment payload, including media loading and filename inference.

methods.name: hydrateAttachmentParamsForAction
methods.description: Hydrates attachment parameters based on specific message actions.

methods.name: parseButtonsParam
methods.description: Parses JSON string for buttons parameter, removing if empty or invalid.

methods.name: parseCardParam
methods.description: Parses JSON string for card parameter, removing if empty or invalid.

methods.name: parseComponentsParam
methods.description: Parses JSON string for components parameter, removing if empty or invalid.

methods.name: parseInteractiveParam
methods.description: Parses JSON string for interactive parameter, removing if empty or invalid.
